evidence_url: https://zh.wikipedia.org/zh-cn/中华人民共和国省级行政区地区生产总值列表
description: 541 of 1526 observations cite Wikipedia (source_agency '国家统计局（维基百科汇编）') as their source URL — GDP (256), GDP per capita (224), population (61). R1 rules forbid non-official sources as the sole source of a final figure. Many values are also third-party aggregator compilations.
reproduction_steps: Open the Gemini observations sheet; filter source_url contains 'wikipedia.org'. Script: pipeline/reconciliation/import_r1.py + audit counts in write_audit.py.
recommended_fix: Re-source from NBS 国家数据 / yearbooks; mark Wikipedia rows E0 (not publishable).

description: All 9110 observations carry verification_status='verified' and EVALUATION.json reports verified_observations = 9110, but the delivered data_validation_samples.csv contains 60 independent checks. The remaining rows were obtained from the same NBS database and never independently checked; this model's data also agrees 99.4% with another model that used the same database (shared provenance, not independent verification).
reproduction_steps: Count verification_status in Gemini 4 Neon observations.csv (9110×'verified'); count rows in its reports/data_validation_samples.csv (60).
recommended_fix: Label as E2 (direct official read) except the 60 sampled rows (E3).

evidence_locator: 公告正文：修订后2023年GDP为1294272亿元
description: 640 GDP / GDP-per-capita values are superseded first-release vintages taken from Jiangsu Statistical Yearbook appendices (one edition per year), e.g. national 2023 GDP 1,260,582 亿元 (pre-revision) vs official revised 1,294,272 (NBS notice 2024-12-27) and 2024 1,349,084 (preliminary) vs final 1,348,066 (NBS notice 2025-12-26). Mixing vintages in one series distorts growth: 2023→2024 nominal growth computes as 7.0% instead of 4.2%. data_status is 'unknown'/'preliminary', not 'superseded'.
reproduction_steps: Filter Codex observations: indicator_id=gdp, geo_level=national; compare with NBS 国家数据 年度数据 > 国内生产总值.
recommended_fix: Use the current official vintage for every year; keep earlier vintages in a separate vintage table.

description: 288 retail-sales values (2015–2023) are first-release figures (e.g. national 2015 300,931 亿元) while the current NBS database gives revised values (286,587.8). Not wrong at publication time, but superseded; mixing makes growth rates inconsistent.
reproduction_steps: Compare Codex retail_sales with NBS 国家数据 社会消费品零售总额 (current).
recommended_fix: Adopt current official vintage; document revisions.

description: 27 provincial 2000 birth-rate values come from 中国卫生健康统计年鉴 (NHC system) and are mixed into the NBS 人口出生率 series; e.g. Beijing 2000: 8.39‰ (NHC table) vs 6.2‰ (NBS). Different statistical systems should not be spliced into one series.
reproduction_steps: Filter Codex birth_rate year=2000; compare with NBS 分省年度数据 人口出生率.
recommended_fix: Keep one statistical system per series or split into separate indicators.

description: Two different observations.csv files are present in the R1 Drive folder (3,813 vs 3,825 rows, different hashes, both modified 2026-11-24 14:19 UTC) without explanation of which is canonical.
reproduction_steps: Download both files (11gUjhBbuBwT2x30h00KGAD2OS1howiWN, 1E_WxwuudRLgGDD2BJ3-K0bgLA5kHvP_v) and compare sha256 (see data/input_manifest).
recommended_fix: Keep one canonical file; version the other explicitly.

description: 10 national birth-rate / urbanization values for 2015–2019 are pre-7th-census figures (e.g. 2015 urbanization 56.10%, current official 57.33%; 2016 birth rate 12.95‰, current 13.57‰) without being labelled as superseded.
reproduction_steps: Compare Muse national series with 《中国统计年鉴2025》表2-6 / NBS current database.
recommended_fix: Use the back-revised official series; keep old values as earlier vintages.

description: Muse's higher_education_students (national) is defined as 普通本专科 + 在学研究生 (documented in its notes) — the same indicator_id as other models' 本专科-only series. Correctly documented, but not comparable under the shared ID; R2 crosswalk maps it to he_students_incl_postgrad.
recommended_fix: Use a distinct indicator_id for the broader scope.

description: 62 GDP-per-capita values for 2011–2012 come from 《中国统计年鉴2016》 and pre-date later economic-census revisions; differences are large for some provinces (Tianjin 2011: 85,213 vs current 62,430 元, −27%). Values were correct for that edition but are superseded.
reproduction_steps: Compare claude_r1a gdp-per-capita 2011–2012 with NBS 国家数据 分省年度数据 人均地区生产总值.
recommended_fix: Prefer the current official vintage; store yearbook-edition values as vintages.

description: quality_report.json lists 5,488 single_reading_ocr and 555 revised_vs_earlier_edition soft warnings. These concern the raw cell set (7,868 cells); published observations are labelled 双重OCR一致 (3,849) / Excel (286) / manual (108) etc. After R2 reconciliation only 4 of its published values remain unexplained, so the warnings do not translate into confirmed errors in published data; revised_vs_earlier_edition reflects genuine official revisions.
reproduction_steps: Read claude_r1a quality_report.json; compare its observations with the canonical candidate (data/reconciliation/conflicts.csv, r1_model=claude_r1a).
recommended_fix: Publish a per-row OCR-reading flag so reviewers can filter single-reading cells.

description: Own R1: student counts were taken from the NBS database in 万人 (2 decimals) and multiplied by 10,000, losing precision (±50 persons; e.g. Guangdong 2024 2,687,600 vs yearbook 2,687,595). Several other models carry exact person counts from yearbooks. R2 keeps the API value but records the rounding bound and classifies these as 'Match Within Official Rounding'.
reproduction_steps: Compare claude_r1run3 higher_education_students with 《中国统计年鉴2025》表21-14.
recommended_fix: Prefer an exact-count official table when available (planned: MOE/yearbook ingestion).

description: Own R1 dropped the official NBS 2000 and 2005–2012 全体居民人均可支配收入 values (288 rows) because of the 2013 survey change, while Gemini 4 Neon kept them with a clear note. R2 restores them under methodology_version '2.0.0-pre2013-backcast' and marks the 2013 break on charts.
reproduction_steps: Compare R1 run3 vs Gemini 4 Neon disposable_income key sets.
recommended_fix: Keep official data; flag methodology breaks rather than delete.

description: Own R1 physicians-per-1000 for ≤2020 uses the post-census revised population as denominator; yearbook prints use pre-revision population (national 2019: 2.74 vs 2.77). Documented in R1; kept.
reproduction_steps: See data/reconciliation/conflicts.csv rows physicians_per_1000, Definition Difference.
recommended_fix: Keep and document; optionally publish both denominators.

description: Grok's observations are only available inside a 21.4 MB ZIP, which exceeds the 10 MB limit of the Drive connector used in this audit; its dataset could not be imported. Its own validation file lists 122 samples (107 yes, 12 no_revision, 3 not_comparable) consistent with its claim of 106 verified rows. The prompt's 125-record physician difference vs Gemini 4 Neon could therefore not be reproduced.
reproduction_steps: Attempt download of Drive file 1DvvC7Vvcq5K52gImOJ-K5qv4FaTSdWrV via connector → size-limit error.
recommended_fix: Publish observations.csv separately (uncompressed or split) in the R1 folder.

description: The folder contains only one checkpoint Google Doc listing unfinished items; no observations, code or reports.
National 2024 retail sales 487,895 亿元 is the first-release communiqué figure; the current NBS database and Yearbook 2025 table 15-12 give 483,344.7. Not labelled as superseded.
